run_torch_model_inference: run a torchvision model like resnet50 on imagenet or cifar10 using GHN2 parameter prediction
run_ghn2_parameter_prediction: run GHN2 to predict all parameters for a torchvision model architecture on a given dataset
run_infer_evaluation: run the infer function to evaluate a model's top1 and top5 accuracy on a validation set
run_adjust_net: run adjust_net to prepare a torchvision model for large input datasets like imagenet
run_capacity_check: run the capacity function to get the parameter count of a predicted model
